retrievalProfile.description: Generates a minimalist, high-contrast dual portrait featuring two subjects cropped at the edges of a stark white frame.
triggerTerms: high-contrast studio lighting on white background
excludeWhen: busy or colorful backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring two male subjects with dreadlocks, each positioned at the extreme left and right edges of the frame, facing inward. The central space is a pure white void, creating a strong sense of symmetry and tension.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between left and right subjects
High contrast between dark hair/skin tones and pure white background
Tight cropping that cuts off the outer halves of the faces
Central vertical axis of negative space
coreInvariants: Pure white background (#FFFFFF) with no shadows or gradients
Subjects must be cropped at the vertical edges of the frame
High-key lighting with deep shadows in facial contours

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale partial faces positioned at the far left and far right margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subjects, which are level and draw the viewer across the central void.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the left face, across the white center, to the right face, and down to the small graphic at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant central white column acting as a separator and focal point.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for stark isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle gold jewelry highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with naturalistic skin saturation.

treatment.fill: black text on white bars / white text on black bars

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family used in varying weights or inverted blocks.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black and white horizontal bars

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the metadata block.
Provides a clean, modern grotesque look suitable for small metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of two men with dreadlocks on a pure white background. Crop the faces so only the inner halves are visible at the left and right edges. Use studio lighting to create deep shadows on the faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, centered rectangular graphic at the bottom containing three rows of condensed uppercase sans-serif text, alternating between black text on white and white text on black.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no shadows?
Are the faces cropped at the extreme left and right edges?
Is the text block centered at the bottom?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure subjects are flush against the frame edges
Verify text is legible and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Dual-edge portrait + high-contrast lighting + central white void + bottom-center metadata block.
